boundary: The hosted surface exposes the frozen canonical-case inspection path only. It does not host the loopback verification or semantic-evaluation API. Evidence verification and semantic-object evaluation remain local capabilities of the archived v0.4.0 release using its frozen Python consumer and verifier.
deploymentAdaptation: index.html adds RISU navigation, hosted-scope disclosure, and local-only labels; hosted.css contains deployment-only chrome. Frozen app.js, styles.css, and cases.json are copied byte-for-byte from the archived v0.4.0 package.
